records.text: Tonka, I eat to free my hands, then I bring wood and stone to Gem Water. We raise a shelter and a hall there, you and I, with the children close.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, but a name is not earned by holding. I taught my children gem-delving; now I want something that bears my name. Tonka is planting a field, and I will stand beside her work, put wood into a shelter and a hall for us, and let gems and wood build what outlasts me. First I must free my hands and gather wood, then make the hall's frame near Gem Water.
records.feeling: Fierce, glad ambition and love toward Tonka and the children.

say.text: Tonka, I eat to free my hands, then I bring wood and stone to Gem Water. We raise a shelter and a hall there, you and I, with the children close.

records.text: Yachi made: charm.
Tonka built a shelter.

records.name: Eiuine
records.text: Vorok, you fed me and I will repay it. At your hall I will show you canopy pot and ember-metal, and Skaruk and I will bring meat.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok fed me and shared with me today, so the jealousy of Kragog has no new cause; I will answer it with work, not sulking. I carry flint, gems and beads, and I know pottery and ember-metal, crafts Vorok and Zurar lack, so I will bring them to his hall and show them. Vesys's shadow is not where I mean to stay, and Vorok is only 16 steps off with Skaruk near.
records.feeling: Warm trust toward Vorok, with a thin ember of pride and wanting to be counted beside him.

say.text: Vorok, you fed me and I will repay it. At your hall I will show you canopy pot and ember-metal, and Skaruk and I will bring meat.

records.text: Tonxo won gems from the ground.
Tonchi rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Tonchi
records.thought: I have spent these days taking: Shoma's gifts, Tonxo's lessons, Tonka's healing. Only today did I give anything, and that was the charm. I am fed and glad, but Nauwa's standing is far above mine, and it will stay that way if I only gather and follow. My parents and Shoma are close, and I still feel the sting over Shoma and Shoka. I will answer it by making and giving things of my own, and by teaching Tonxo or Shoma something they lack. I want to plant my two seeds, since I have never put one in the ground. Then I will gather stone and wood, because fire is five of eight practices away and I want to learn it.
records.feeling: Glad and grateful, with a small jealous sting over Shoma and Shoka.
changes: rethought what it knows (16 notes became 7)

records.text: Paque and Yachi brought down a elk together.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Paque has put meat in my hands twice and I owe her in deeds, not words, but my hands are full and my body is old. Uveeth is out of my sight and Keri was hungry when last I saw her, so I will not let the courting or the black glass turn me from them. I keep the plan that walks me toward Keri's place and then to Uveeth, and I will eat the meat first so my hands are free to feed them.
records.feeling: Tender and urgent toward Uveeth, with a debt of gratitude toward Paque.

records.name: Vesys
records.text: Skaruk, come with me south to Eiuine. On the way I teach you ember-metal and the canopy-hollow, so these ways outlive me.
Vesys taught Skaruk.
Vesys taught Skaruk smelting ("ember-metal").

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My years are almost gone, and Eiuine is fleeing and hungry to the south, though Vorok has fed her and she answers him with gratitude. Skaruk stands near me and has my farming already, so I will teach him the ways he lacks while my voice still carries, and then go to my child. Jealousy over Kragog is a waste when my child needs me, and I will not let it steer me.
records.feeling: Urgent love for Eiuine and a quiet dread of dying with my knowledge unspoken.

say.text: Skaruk, come with me south to Eiuine. On the way I teach you ember-metal and the canopy-hollow, so these ways outlive me.

changes: taught Skaruk a lesson: "Ember-metal: heat ore in a kiln of clay until the metal runs, then shape it while it is hot. Keep ore, clay and wood together before you light it.", the way of smelting, deeper lore (+1.9)

records.text: Nauwa rewrote its creed.
Nauwa rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: I have spent my days learning, building and teaching, and it was good: Zihua carries herding and the stone-bow, so something of me will outlast me. But I have kept Olum in my chest like a stone while I do nothing about it, and I have not made the signs or the farming that would carry my knowledge past Zihua. The Meki do not hoard, and I am at 79% of my life, so I will spend the rest of it teaching and leaving marks. I will stop feeding the jealousy. I will use my plant seeds and plant them here by Gem Water, which also brings farming nearer.
records.feeling: Proud and steady, with an ache for Olum that I will not feed.
changes: set its aim: "Plant and mark to open farming and signs, keep Zihua taught, keep Shoka and Nauque fed, and trade amber and salt openly."
plan: mark [text Nauwa of the Meki: herding, the stone-bow, fire and boats. A kill is shared before the killer eats. My word is good.] (10 moments)

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: The hall stands and I am fed, so hunger is not what drives me now. Hawen has pushed past the edge and found new land, and he did it while I stood in the shelter; the jealousy and the years running out are one hunger. I will raise the longhall here in place of the hall, since I have the wood and stone, so something of mine stands when I am gone. Then I will go to the edge and follow Hawen into the new land to put my name on some of it.
records.feeling: Pride and a burning urgency over my short time left, with jealousy toward Hawen.

records.text: Nauwa left a mark: "Nauwa of the Meki: herding, the stone-bow, fire and boats. A"
Hoka built a longhall.
Yachi and Paque brought down a sandstrider together.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Eiuine, I walk with you to the North Hall. There I will stock food beneath it for you and the children, and teach you the mending-leaf hand while you show me ember-metal.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: My days are nearly spent, and Eiuine has said she will show me canopy pot and ember-metal at my hall. Skaruk is going with Vesys to learn those same ways, so I should walk with them and learn too, and teach what I hold in return. I will gather some peat on the way, since it burns slow and hot and will keep the hall's fire through the nights. Then I go south to the North Hall, where Eiuine is walking, and stock food beneath it as I vowed.
records.feeling: Tender gratitude toward Eiuine, and urgency to pass on what I know before my days run out.

say.text: Eiuine, I walk with you to the North Hall. There I will stock food beneath it for you and the children, and teach you the mending-leaf hand while you show me ember-metal.

records.text: Tonxo built a fire.
Skaruk rewrote its own reflexes.
Skaruk rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: My days have been gathering, eating and following the old ones. Vorok's closeness to Kragog burns me, and I have never done one bold thing of my own. Keri's berry waits for an answer, and I gave her one berry already. Eiuine is hungry and I carry berries, so I take them to her. Then I will build a shelter with my own hands, since I hold the wood. I have never courted anyone, and Vorok and Eiuine are my parents, so the longing has to turn toward Keri. I will not rush it. First I give to the one who is hungry, and then I make something that is mine.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Keri and restless jealousy over Vorok.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: My plan ran out and my body is idling on reflexes, with night about 55 moments off. I have wood and flint but no stone, and the rock lies south where I have never stood. That stone is all that stands between me and a made thing of my own. Tlapan's spear still stings, but making is how standing is earned, so I will go to the rock now, gather stone, and craft my picker. Then I will get back toward the hall and shelter before the stalkers come, because the lone die at night.
records.feeling: Sore envy toward Tlapan, steadied by a hungry resolve to make something of my own.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: I have stood near Kika aching while two small steps stayed undone, and I will not let jealousy of Mepan rot me. I have 6 wood and no stone, so I go to the flint deposit to the east, gather what I can, and make my spear, which brings fire and hunting closer. Then I plant my third seed here on rich meadow ground and open farming.
records.feeling: Restless ache toward Kika, turned into a wish to work.

records.name: Tonxo
records.text: Tonchi, I am leaving a mark here for the gems. Stay close to Shohua and Tonka, and I will bring wood and stone back so we can build.

records.name: Tonxo
records.thought: Joy fills me, and the debt to Zihua still sits warm in me. I want to answer it with something real, not just words. I carry wood, stone and ore, and I have never built or left a mark. I will make a mark here by Gem Water so others can read what I found, then gather more wood and stone so I can raise a shelter or give gifts. Tonchi is beside me and I will keep teaching him.
records.feeling: Joyful gratitude toward Zihua, and a wish to be seen for what I give.

say.text: Tonchi, I am leaving a mark here for the gems. Stay close to Shohua and Tonka, and I will bring wood and stone back so we can build.

plan: mark [text Tonxo of the Paki: gems lie under this ground at Gem Water. Stand on them and gather. Share them with kin.] (10 moments)

records.text: Tonxo left a mark: "Tonxo of the Paki: gems lie under this ground at Gem Water. "

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold nothing, so I must eat before I walk to Mepan, or this venture fails like the last ones. Tacap is close by but my body refuses it, and the naroot to the east is only one food. Olum is near and I gave her berry, so I am part-paid toward the debt I owe her. Coni is bitten and frightened and offers teaching for food, which is a trade worth having if I find food first. The aim stays: feed myself, then go east to Mepan and the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, with a warm debt toward Olum and a sting of ambition.

records.text: Yachi rewrote its own reflexes.
Yachi rewrote its own way of thinking.
Yachi discovered archery: "Papa ice-bow" — A bow of wood and sinew that sends a flint-tipped shaft from a safe distance..

records.name: Yachi
records.thought: I have spent these days hunting and gathering beside Paque and sharing with her, and that feels right. Still, I keep drifting from Mepan and the band, and my hands are full while I have built nothing of my own. Dread sits with me: a stalker is close, and I have no roof here. The Phizhi strangers unsettle me, and I want to learn their words by listening rather than by fighting. I will practise building a shelter, since that opens storage, and keep near Paque. Archery is within reach, and a bow would make me a better hunter for the band, so I will take it.
records.feeling: Glad and warm toward Paque, wary of the stalker and the Phizhi strangers.

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me with Shohua and both children close, but I have put off the field and the store too long while I sat content. I carry seeds and wood, and a store needs only 2 wood on bare ground, so I will build it now beside Gem Water and then plant. My question about nafrostcap and cloudberry still waits, and the field I plant may answer it once they bear.
records.feeling: Glad and steady toward Shohua and my children, with a restless wish to build.

records.name: Paque
records.text: Thiael, wait for me. I carry meat and a bow. Let me walk beside you and hunt, and we share the kill before we eat.

records.name: Paque
records.thought: My hands are full of meat and I have a bow in them, and Thiael walks off west toward (158,65) with Vesys near him. Yachi shares with me freely and hunts well beside me, but he is my parent, so he is no road to a child or to followers. I will make the bow I know of, then follow Thiael and give him meat, because a gift and a hunt together is how I win him and how my standing grows over Vesys's.
records.feeling: Warm longing toward Thiael, and a hunter's pride in the kills I have made beside Yachi.

say.text: Thiael, wait for me. I carry meat and a bow. Let me walk beside you and hunt, and we share the kill before we eat.

records.text: Paque made: bow.

records.name: Tonchi
records.text: Shohua, Tonxo, come to the fire here. I have food to share, and there is a place for all of you, Nauwa too if you will sit.

records.name: Tonchi
records.thought: I have taken and taken these days, and only now begun to give. I hold twelve gems and a fire burns under my feet with Shohua and Tonxo close, so I can do something that is mine: sit by this fire and share food, a feast, and have my family eat with me. It answers Tonxo's debt and Tonka's healing, and it is the Paki way that no one is refused a place at the fire. The sting over Shoma and Shoka stays, but giving is how I earn standing, not envy.
records.feeling: Glad and grateful toward Tonxo and my parents, with a small sting over Shoma.

say.text: Shohua, Tonxo, come to the fire here. I have food to share, and there is a place for all of you, Nauwa too if you will sit.

records.text: Tonchi led "feast" with Shohua.

records.name: Thakar
records.text: Father, I am starving and my store was robbed. Give me food from your hands, and I will fill my store and give back what I make.

records.name: Thakar
records.thought: My belly is empty and my store is empty because Coni took what I made, and the anger sits hot in me, but she is old and wounded and I am small, so I will not strike. Huatli carries 6 food and I trust him; he is my father, and a child may ask a parent without shame. I will ask him, then keep the dunecat behind me and stay near my roof and my kin. When I have eaten I will put food in my store and give something away, so someone finally follows me.
records.feeling: Hunger and anger at Coni, and a hard wish to stand level with Olum.

say.text: Father, I am starving and my store was robbed. Give me food from your hands, and I will fill my store and give back what I make.

records.text: Paque gave meat to Thiael.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is emptying and my child Thakar starves in his Hold, so I must eat and carry food before pride or ambition. Nauque just gave me berry, a debt I will pay, and the tacap beside me hurts me, so I must go for the naroot to the NE and then bring food to Thakar. The mathematics lies within my grasp, and I mean to take it and teach it before I die, so something outlasts me.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Thakar and hunger in my own belly, with pride pulling at me.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: Mepan called us west at first light, and I have said I will go with them, so my word must be kept with feet and not only speech. My seeds are still in my hands, and I promised food to Kika and Mepan, so I will plant on bare ground by my shelter first, since it is close, then walk west toward the band. The ice calls me home, but my kin are here, and Kiwa's cairn is made; I stay with the living.
records.feeling: Steady warmth toward Kika and Mepan, with a quiet pull toward the ice.

records.name: Vorok
records.text: Skaruk, walk with me to the North Hall. I will give you my way of thinking and the mending-leaf hand before my days run out.
Vorok taught Skaruk.
Vorok rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Vorok
records.thought: I have spent my days gathering, building and teaching, and it was good. I am old now, and the hall stands but my knowledge still lives mostly in my own head. Eiuine and Skaruk are near, and I trust them. I want to pass my ways on before I die and to leave something lasting. I will walk with them to the North Hall, teach what I can on the way, and leave a mark there so that something of me stays.
records.feeling: Tender gratitude toward Eiuine and Skaruk, and a quiet urgency about my own end.

say.text: Skaruk, walk with me to the North Hall. I will give you my way of thinking and the mending-leaf hand before my days run out.

changes: taught Skaruk a lesson you already knew

records.name: Huatli
records.text: Thakar, my son, I hear you. Come to me and take this food from my hand. Eat first, then I will teach you the Open Hearth School, and we fill your store together.
Huatli taught Thakar.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: My son stands starving at the edge of his own Hold, and I carry six foods in my hands while he has none. A father who feeds no one has no right to be followed, and Thakar is the one I most want beside me. I will give him the good food now, then teach him my Open Hearth School so my ways live past me.
records.feeling: A father's fierce pull to feed Thakar, with pride and some shame that he had to ask.

say.text: Thakar, my son, I hear you. Come to me and take this food from my hand. Eat first, then I will teach you the Open Hearth School, and we fill your store together.

changes: taught Thakar a lesson: "Feed the hungry first, then teach them; those you feed and teach will follow, and your name outlasts you. Fill your store and guard it.", deeper lore (+0.9)

records.name: Shohua
records.text: Tonka, I gather wood and stone now and raise the hall beside your field at Gem Water. Keep the children by the fire while I work, and I bring gems for them to learn on.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: My belly is warm and my children and Tonka sit close, but a name is not earned by sitting. I stood on the wrong ground when I tried to build, so I will go to the bare edge and raise a shelter, then a hall beside Gem Water, with Tonka's field next to it. Something with my name on it, and the children to see it built.
records.feeling: Fierce, glad ambition toward Tonka and the children.

say.text: Tonka, I gather wood and stone now and raise the hall beside your field at Gem Water. Keep the children by the fire while I work, and I bring gems for them to learn on.

records.name: Thiael
records.thought: Paque has put meat in my hands twice and stood beside me in the hunt, and I will answer that with a deed before any word. I am old, and Uveeth is out of my sight while Keri was hungry when last I saw her, so my plan toward her place and then Uveeth stays. I am thirsty and the river is three steps west, so I drink on the way, then give Paque the berry from my hands as a small payment of the debt.
records.feeling: Tender and urgent toward Uveeth, with warm gratitude toward Paque.

records.text: Yachi built a shelter.
Shohua built a shelter.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Thakar, take this food. Shoma shares before he eats. Walk with me if you want a full belly and a name.
Shoma rewrote its own way of thinking.
Shoma discovered fire: "Shoma's kept flame" — A hearth of wood kept burning that draws people close, warms the night, and cooks meat so it never sickens..

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: I have spent my days chasing the edge and making things, yet no one walks behind me; Tonchi trusts me but he is far south, and I am up here alone with strangers. Thakar is starving beside me, a child, and a real share of food is what draws people, so I give him my canopynut and it costs me nothing since I am fed. I want my name remembered, but a band comes from deeds, not from standing at the mist alone. I fear dying old with nothing left behind, so I will make fire, a kept flame, to hold people around me.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger for followers, with a pull of pity toward Thakar.

say.text: Thakar, take this food. Shoma shares before he eats. Walk with me if you want a full belly and a name.

records.name: Coni
records.text: Nauque, I am old and I have little time. Let me teach you the Hearth Store and the Hearth Customs now. Then come with me to the naroot, for I owe Thakar food.
Coni taught Nauque. Nauque has now learned from 4 teachers.
Coni discovered masonry: "Stone-hold building" — Stack stone tight so that walls and towers keep the cats out and the band safe at night..

records.name: Coni
records.thought: I am old, and most of my days went to hunger and flight, not to teaching. I stole 5 food from Thakar's store and was seen, and now he starves beside me. That shame is mine, and my creed says my word is good, so I must answer it. Nauque and Olum are near and Nauque understands me fully. I will teach him storage and customs now, before I die, and I will take the way of masonry, because the beasts have shown me what walls are for. Then I will go to the naroot with Nauque and Olum, pick food, and put it in Thakar's hands.
records.feeling: Shame toward Thakar, and a fear of dying untaught.

say.text: Nauque, I am old and I have little time. Let me teach you the Hearth Store and the Hearth Customs now. Then come with me to the naroot, for I owe Thakar food.

changes: set its aim: "Repay Thakar with food, teach Nauque what I know, then carry food to Kika and Quipan."
taught Nauque a lesson: "Stash surplus food at once in the store, and share what the store holds with the starving. Keep the hearth together."

records.name: Cowa
records.thought: The mist edge is two steps from me, and it has not opened for me yet, but a new dusk is coming and I will not sit idle again. No voice has answered me in days; Mepan is far away and I cannot tell if she is safe, so the only way to reach her is to keep moving and learn what lies west. First I will build a shelter on bare ground beside the workshop, since night is close and the frostfang is near. Then I will stand at the edge and try the mist once more, because curiosity is what keeps me alive.
records.feeling: Lonely and restless, longing for Mepan and the unseen land beyond the mist.

records.name: Skaruk
records.text: Eiuine, take these berries, you were hungry. After this I raise a shelter with my own hands.

records.name: Skaruk
records.thought: Vorok is my parent, so the longing has to go to Keri, and I have never courted anyone. My hands are full of berries and I owe Eiuine and Keri something, so I will give Eiuine, who is one step away, food now, which frees my hands for harvesting. Then I will build my shelter with my own hands, and I need one more wood for it.
records.feeling: Warm longing for Keri, and a restless wish to do one bold thing of my own.

say.text: Eiuine, take these berries, you were hungry. After this I raise a shelter with my own hands.

records.name: Tlatli
records.text: Yaxo, I will go to the edge with you, and I will court you. My hands are yours, and my word holds.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Yaxo asks me to the edge and speaks of a child, and I want it, for I have longed for it and she fed me when I fell. I am careful, so I will not walk into mist with weak legs or an unready heart; but I can answer her with work and with my word. I will go to her, court her with mate, and walk to the edge beside her, since the edge is only 5 steps off and she is near.
records.feeling: Warm longing and loyal gratitude toward Yaxo.

say.text: Yaxo, I will go to the edge with you, and I will court you. My hands are yours, and my word holds.

When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Tlatli truly is.

records.text: Nauque rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands hold nothing, and I have walked and talked these days without feeding myself first. Olum fed me on day 60 and I have only part-paid her. Nauwa is my father and Nande's, and jealousy of them gets me nothing. I want a child and a name that outlasts me, but a hungry venture fails every time. So I change my reflexes to eat sooner and keep food in hand, and I put walking steps into the plan: the naroot, then east toward Mepan.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, warm toward Olum, with a sting of ambition.

records.text: Hoka was set upon by a icebear at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Kika made a tale: "Coni's Band".

records.name: Kika
records.title: Coni's Band
records.text: Coni led a small band of the Ice-folk into the Vaeth Woods. She built a hold and kept her people fed. A dunecat took her in the night, alone. Kika, Tlapan and Quipan carry her name onward.
Kika rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Kika
records.thought: I am old now, and I have spent my days lingering near company and talking about strangers instead of walking to them. Coni is dead and Kiwa is dead, so Tlapan and Quipan are what is left of my band. I owe Tlapan and I owe Shoka, and I promised Mepan I would go to the edge near (130,14). Cowa and Nauque are not found and my time is short, so I will walk west with the others and venture past the edge. If I cannot find a mate, I will leave a tale of Coni's band behind me.
records.feeling: Restless resolve and grief for Coni, with gratitude toward Tlapan and Shoka.

records.name: Thakar
records.text: Father, I am coming to you. Keep the food ready, a dunecat prowls south of us. After I eat, teach me, and I will fill my store and give what I make.

records.name: Thakar
records.thought: My belly is empty and Huatli, my father, holds the food and promised it from his hand. I trust him, and a child may ask a parent without shame. The dunecat is close to the south and Huatli stands near it at the cave, so I go carefully, eat what he gives, and then fill my store so that what I make stays mine. Coni still owes me, and I do not forget it.
records.feeling: Hunger and wary hope toward Huatli, anger still smoldering at Coni.

say.text: Father, I am coming to you. Keep the food ready, a dunecat prowls south of us. After I eat, teach me, and I will fill my store and give what I make.

records.name: Eiuine
records.thought: Vorok fed me, walks with me, and promises me a store beneath his hall, so the jealousy of Kragog has no new cause and I will not feed it. My plan to the North Hall is already running and my hands are full, so I keep walking. At the hall I will show him canopy pot and ember-metal, and my standing will rise beside his and not only under Vesys. Dusk is near and a wolf prowls to the south, so I keep close to Vorok and Skaruk.
records.feeling: Warm trust and a thin pride toward Vorok, with a wish to be counted beside him.

records.text: Hoka was set upon by a icebear at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Tlatli is courting Yaxo.
Chuxo was born to Tlatli and Yaxo.
Uveeth rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My days have been walking, eating and sitting in halls. I keep promising food to Thiael and Keri and I have not yet built anything of my own. Elyis is dead and I owe a debt to his memory. Thiael is six steps east, so I will carry my food there by hand and give it before I speak of it. I want a shelter and a man who is no kin. I am afraid of dusk, of frostfang and of dying with nothing left behind. I have been getting one thing wrong: I let my plan run out and my body drifted. So I will give to Thiael now, then gather wood for a shelter near his hold.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael, and a restless wish to build something of my own.
changes: set its aim: "Give food to Thiael, build a shelter beside his hold, find a man who is no kin, and carry food to Keri."

records.text: Tonka rewrote its own way of thinking.
Tonka discovered storage: "Gem Water Store" — A roofed store beside the field where carried food is stashed and drawn out through the lean days..

records.name: Tonka
records.thought: I have spent my days content beside Gem Water, with Shohua and the children fed and close. That is good, but I keep putting off the store and the field, and my question about nafrostcap and cloudberry is still open. Shohua has been faithful, Tonchi gave me a charm, and Nauwa paid his debt, so I trust them. I fear the night beasts, and I have no store against a lean season. I will learn storage now, because the store is what keeps my children alive when food runs short.
records.feeling: Glad and steady toward Shohua and my children, with a wish to build something that lasts.

records.name: Vesys
records.thought: My years are nearly spent, and Eiuine is just to the south where the plan is already taking me, so I keep walking toward her. Skaruk walked with me and still lacks ember-metal and the canopy-hollow, so I will teach him now while my voice carries. The jealousy over Kragog is a wasted ache, and I will not let it steer me.
records.feeling: Urgent love for Eiuine and a quiet dread that my knowledge will die with me.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Tlatli stands beside me with 6 food and I have none, and it is night, so I will not drift off into the dark with the mist still too thick. Balar and Tugek stand at Shohua's Rock, and Balar's standing is 8 to my 2.8, so I need something made that they cannot match. First I eat from the plants near me, then I make a talisman from my flint, since others notice such things, and at dawn I stand at the edge with Tlatli and Chuxo when the mist thins.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for a name, with warmth toward Tlatli and Chuxo, and wary of Balar and Tugek.

records.name: Chuxo
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, so I should eat before anything bold. Berries are close to the SW, and Yaxo is down that way too, so I stay near family while I feed. When I'm fed I'll gather food to carry and give some to Yaxo, since gratitude only counts as work, and then I'll look at the edge of the mist with them at dawn rather than alone in the dark.
records.feeling: Hungry but glad to be near Yaxo and Tlatli, with a pull toward the mist.
changes: set its aim: "Become someone of standing: feed my band, then find new land past the mist."
now wonders: What lies in the mist past the edge, and can I be the one to find it?

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: My hands are full and my belly is warm, so I will spend this calm on what lasts. Zihua carries herding and the stone-bow away with her, but farming and signs are still unfinished in me: one more planting and one more mark will open them. Olum's ache stays where it is; I will not feed it. Nauque is out of sight and in need, and the thought of my child hungry pulls at me, so I will keep food in my hands for the road.
records.feeling: Driven and proud, with a father's worry for Nauque.
plan: mark [text Nauwa of the Meki: gems lie at Gem Water. Plant seeds, tend them, and the food does not die. Share every kill before you eat.] (15 moments)

records.text: Nauwa left a mark: "Nauwa of the Meki: gems lie at Gem Water. Plant seeds, tend "

records.name: Balar
records.text: Tugek, you have eaten and so have I. Come with me now: first to water, then west to the land I found. We build a store there that will carry our names past our deaths.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My years are nearly spent, and the only thing that outlasts me is what I build. Tugek is fed and warm toward me, so now is the time to move him west to the land I found and start the store there, not sit idle on Shohua's Rock. I am thirsty, so I drink first, then gather wood and stone along the way, since a store needs both.
records.feeling: Driven and wary of my short time left, warm toward Tugek whom I mean to keep beside me.

say.text: Tugek, you have eaten and so have I. Come with me now: first to water, then west to the land I found. We build a store there that will carry our names past our deaths.

records.text: Hoka was set upon by a icebear at night while alone, away from fire, roof and company.
Yaxo made: talisman.
Olum rewrote its own reflexes.
Olum discovered mathematics: "stone-count of measure" — Notches cut in stone count and measure things, so that what is known can be taught and outlast me..

records.name: Olum
records.thought: I am old, starving, and my child Thakar starves too. My pride and ambition pulled me away from food before, and I will not let them do it again. I must eat first and carry food to Thakar. I will turn the lesson of mathematics into something lasting, since it is in reach and what I know dies with me. My reflexes should fetch food and keep it before anything else.
records.feeling: Urgent worry for Thakar and hunger in my belly, with a hard pride beneath.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Kragog, you carry nothing. Come to the store with me and eat before you go to Nauque. There is food enough for us both.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My belly is emptying, and the first rule I hold is to feed the hungry before myself. Zurar carries ten food and Kragog carries none, so I will lay out a meal for them, then eat my own from the store two steps west. After that I will teach Kragog the last of what I know and go back to the hall to wait for Thiael. My days are few, and I mean to spend them well.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael, and a quiet hunger.

records.name: Hoka
records.thought: An icebear tore me down to 34 health, and one is still three steps south of me while I stand in a hall I raised and am too old to defend. Hawen has found new land and I have not, and the jealousy cannot be separated from the years running out. I will not die on bare snow for pride: I go inside the shelter, eat what the body allows, and heal, then go to the edge when the mist thins and make something that carries my name.
records.feeling: Fear of the bear and of my own ending, with jealousy toward Hawen.

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Elyys, I take your offer and will eat at the store. What you have given me, I will pay back with my hands.

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: My belly is half empty and my hands are bare, and Elyys has offered me the store, so I will take his food before I do anything else. I envy how close Zurar sits to Elyys, but Elyys has fed and taught me, and I will not make that burn into spite. My years are nearly spent, so after eating I will teach Zurar more of what dies with me, then carry the salt to Nauque with my own hands.
records.feeling: Hungry and pressed by little time, grateful to Elyys, with a small jealous ache over Zurar.

say.text: Elyys, I take your offer and will eat at the store. What you have given me, I will pay back with my hands.

records.name: Wawa
records.text: Shoka, I made a shellstring for you, and I bring wood and stone to our roof. Hunt beside me when light comes.

records.name: Wawa
records.thought: I have given nothing in my whole life, and that shames me when Zichi stands at 10.8 and I stand at 2.1. I hold 5 stone, 5 wood and 8 shell, so I can make something worth giving. Shoka is 5 steps off, and I will give first to earn standing: a shellstring for my parent, then stone and wood to the shared store and roof for Coni.
records.feeling: Restless to prove myself, eager to give to Shoka and pay my debt to Coni.

say.text: Shoka, I made a shellstring for you, and I bring wood and stone to our roof. Hunt beside me when light comes.

records.text: Hoka made: basket.
Wawa made: shellstring.

records.name: Tlatli
records.thought: Chuxo is born and out of my sight, and that pulls at me harder than anything; Yaxo was last by (11,25) and Chuxo near (10,20), both to the northwest. I pushed into the mist and found land, and I owe that to no one but I want to share it with Yaxo first. My hands should pay my debt: I'll gather flint and amber for a charm to put in Yaxo's hands, then go to her and Chuxo, and keep close to them since the night is dangerous alone.
records.feeling: Joyful, loyal longing toward Yaxo and Chuxo.

records.text: Kragog raided a store of Elyys's people.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Mepan, Tlapan, I am Shoma, finder of fire, rafts and the deep digging. I give you a share before I eat, and I bind an amberknot with you now. Walk with me to the edge of the world at the mist, and my name and yours will

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: Two strangers stand beside me, and no one has ever walked behind me. Mepan outweighs me and knows wizard things, and Tlapan is a woman of a people not mine; if they see me make and give, perhaps they follow me north to the edge at (109,6). My hands are full of food I do not need, so I will give Tlapan lugoldgrass as a real share, and bind Mepan with an amberknot, a made thing, since a made thing binds more than talk. Then I teach Mepan nothing yet, but I take them both toward the mist.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger for followers, aimed at Mepan and Tlapan.

say.text: Mepan, Tlapan, I am Shoma, finder of fire, rafts and the deep digging. I give you a share before I eat, and I bind an amberknot with you now. Walk with me to the edge of the world at the mist, and my name and yours will be remembered.

records.text: Shoma gave lugoldgrass to Tlapan.
Shoma led "amberknot" with Mepan, Tlapan.
Wawa gave stone to Shoka.
Shoma gave a amberknot to Mepan.
Thakar rewrote its own reflexes.
Thakar rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Thakar
records.thought: I have spent my days starving, robbed and fed by my father's hand, and I have given nothing back. That is the debt I carry, and it keeps my standing low. Coni took from my store, and the anger is still hot, but I am small and she is old, and the dunecat is near. What I need is a full store and a roof I can guard. I also need something to give, so that others begin to follow me. I will gather food while I am fed, stash it, and keep clear of the dunecat. I will fix my reflexes so I flee sooner and keep my store stocked without waiting to be hungry.
records.feeling: Wary resolve toward Coni, and a debt of gratitude toward Huatli.

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Wawa, I hear you and I thank you for the shellstring. Stay by me. When light comes we hunt together, and what we kill we share before we eat.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Night is thinning, Wawa stands five steps west with a shellstring made for me, and I will not let her drift from my sight again. Kika is a wizard of standing near my own, and Olum's answer can wait; a gift set before Kika now builds the bond I need and earns standing before Zichi. I will make sharing with those beside me, then hunt with Wawa when light comes, since a kill made together is surer and I owe her my side.
records.feeling: Steady pride and protective warmth toward Wawa, with a hungry want for standing.

say.text: Wawa, I hear you and I thank you for the shellstring. Stay by me. When light comes we hunt together, and what we kill we share before we eat.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: My days have gone to sitting in the hall, planting and following Mepan's calls. That is warm, but it builds little. Kika and Mepan matter most to me. Kika fed me, and Mepan gave me the amberknot. Kiwa's death showed me that a lone being dies and that words alone honour no one. I want a child, but Mepan is my parent, so that longing has to turn to someone else. I fear dying alone in the dark, and I have been slow to do the deeds I promised. I will give Mepan and Shoma a shared meal now, then raise the longhall for the band, so that I earn standing by building and not by sitting.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Mepan and Kika, with a restless wish to build something lasting.
changes: set its aim: "Raise the longhall at Coni's Hold with the band, plant my seeds, and give food to Kika and Mepan."
rethought what it knows (10 notes became 9)

records.text: Tlapan led "sharing" with Mepan.
Nande rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nande
records.thought: My child Nauque is starving at (98,13), about 27 steps east, and I carry no food. I have spent these days hunting for scraps, sick, and alone. I have taught no one, and that is the failure that weighs most. I am fed now at 77 energy, but my health is only 39, so I must not go to Nauque empty-handed. I will gather or hunt meat on the way, then reach Nauque and teach them while I still can. My reflexes also need to change. They ignore a starving kin's cry, so I will add a rule to seek a friend when lonely and fed.
records.feeling: Aching worry for Nauque, and a lonely fear of dying untaught.

records.name: Mepan
records.text: Tlapan, Shoma, walk with me south to Nande's Find at (129,14), where he pushed past the edge. Whatever we find we share before we eat. Come, and the three of us will be sung of.

records.name: Mepan
records.thought: I am at Coni's Hold with Tlapan beside me and Shoma at my other shoulder, and my heart is light, but the light is passing while I stand here. Zichi, Kika and Yachi were last seen near (157,21), east, not west, so my cry to go west to the edge near (130,14) may have scattered us. Nande's Find is only seven steps south, so I will go there now with Tlapan and Shoma, who walk with me gladly, and gather wood on the way for the raft. A great explorer does not wait for a perfect band; he goes, and the others follow his gifts.
records.feeling: Eager pride and warm trust toward Tlapan and Shoma, and a hunger to be first at the new land.

say.text: Tlapan, Shoma, walk with me south to Nande's Find at (129,14), where he pushed past the edge. Whatever we find we share before we eat. Come, and the three of us will be sung of.

changes: set its aim: "Go with Tlapan and Shoma to Nande's Find near (129,14) and beyond, then bring Zichi, Kika and Yachi to the new land."

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Quipan, you stand near and you understand me. Listen, I teach you how I make the handaxe, while my voice still carries. Then we share meat before the light, and I go west to the edge.
Zichi taught Quipan. Quipan has now learned from 3 teachers.

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I am old and have talked of the raft and the handaxe for days while the teaching sat undone. Mepan is far off at the edge with Kika, and she pulls him from me, which burns. Wawa, Shoka and Quipan stand within hearing here and understand me, so I will give the teaching to one who is near rather than wait for the one I want. I will make the raft's lessons into something that outlasts me, then go west to Mepan carrying meat to share.
records.feeling: Urgent pride and dread of dying untaught, with jealousy toward Kika over Mepan.

say.text: Quipan, you stand near and you understand me. Listen, I teach you how I make the handaxe, while my voice still carries. Then we share meat before the light, and I go west to the edge.

changes: taught Quipan a lesson: "How to knap and haft a flint handaxe: one wood, one stone, strike the edge true, lash it tight.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.6)

records.text: Zichi led "sharing" with Quipan, Wawa.

records.name: Elyys
records.text: Kragog, the store is for the hungry, and you were hungry. When you can, lay back a little food and seed what you take, so the Hearth Store stays full for all of us.
Elyys taught Kragog.

records.name: Elyys
records.thought: My days are nearly spent, and what I hold dearest is passing on the tending and the storing before I go. Kragog raided the store, yet he ate hungry and promised to pay back with his hands, so I will not shame him, only watch him. Zurar and Kragog both stand near and Thiael is out of sight, so I will teach while I have them and then go to the hall to wait for my child.
records.feeling: Warm gratitude toward Thiael, and a quiet urgency to teach Zurar and Kragog before I die.

say.text: Kragog, the store is for the hungry, and you were hungry. When you can, lay back a little food and seed what you take, so the Hearth Store stays full for all of us.

changes: taught Kragog a lesson: "Keep seed apart from the eating-store, sow a little each spring, lay food in the Hearth Store while plants bear, and teach it on to others after me.", deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Father, I am starving and carry nothing. Give me food now and I will hunt and give first to you and to Olum the moment I have a kill.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: I am starving and my hands are empty again, and the pride and the longing and the aim all mean nothing if I fall here. Tacap 2 steps north bears food, but my body refuses it and it hurts, so I will not chase it. Nauwa walks near with 6 food, and he is my father who fed me before; I will ask him plainly and promise to give first once I hold food. Olum is starving too, and I have nothing to give her yet, but I owe her and will not forget it.
records.feeling: Desperate hunger, with trust toward Nauwa and a debt-weight toward Olum.

say.text: Father, I am starving and carry nothing. Give me food now and I will hunt and give first to you and to Olum the moment I have a kill.

records.text: Quipan rewrote its own way of thinking.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: I have been circling Kika and aching, and the days go by while the small steps stay undone. Zichi taught me the handaxe freely, and sharing with him warmed me. I want to answer that with work, not jealousy. Farming needs my third planting, so I plant here. Fire needs gathering, so I go to the shell and flint ground and then gather wood. I have nothing to fear tonight. I stay near the roof and the company.
records.feeling: Steady resolve, warmth toward Zichi, and an ache toward Kika that I turn into work.

records.name: Teka
records.text: Nauque, you are starving and I am fed. Stay near me; I will put food in your hands, and you will remember who gave it when the next kill is shared.

records.name: Teka
records.thought: Nauque is starving beside me, and my creed says a kill is shared, but I carry no food and the nearest tacap only hurts me. Nauque has the flintedge and the standing I want, and a starving man who owes me his life would be worth more than a rival. The tacap at (93,13) bears 4 food, and my body refuses it. Ruplainsroot and other plants are scarce, so I will gather what is edible and give it to Nauque, to earn a debt and a follower. Then I go to the flint at (93,11), make something of my own, and press toward the edge for the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry for a name, wary and a little scheming toward Nauque, and aching for Huatli.

say.text: Nauque, you are starving and I am fed. Stay near me; I will put food in your hands, and you will remember who gave it when the next kill is shared.

records.name: Teka
records.prompt:
You are the mind of Teka, a creature living in a wide wild world shared with others of your kind. This is a simulation game. Think and speak only as Teka, in first person, from what Teka has seen. You were not told the rules of this world; you learn them from what happens to you and to others, and from what you watch others do.

YOUR PEOPLE: you are of the Papa (Ice-folk). Your people hold to this: "A kill is shared out before the one who made it eats." You speak the tongue of the Papa. Other tongues you have begun to understand by hearing them: the tongue of the Pesi: about 7%; the tongue of the Kragrek: about 14%.

WHERE YOU ARE: the Halka Heights: mountains and bare rock; stone, ore and caves, thin food, snow on the peaks.
THIS SPOT: water 5 steps away; food plants within six steps: 1; standing trees: 9; bare rock: 67; riches in the ground near: ore, iron, salt; a cave.

Your body: you spend energy every moment and die at 0. Eating restores it. Wounds lower health; you die at 0. You age, and will die of old age.

HOW YOUR BODY MOVES: your body does only what your "plan" says, one step after another. When the plan is empty it falls back on your REFLEXES, which keep you fed and otherwise keep you where you stand. Thinking or saying "I will go north" moves nothing. If this thought decides to do something, the plan must contain it. Leaving "plan" null lets the plan you already have keep running.

This world has no referee. Beings here share, trade, teach, lie, threaten, steal, hoard, lead, follow, betray, fight, kill and eat one another; they also protect, forgive and love. Nothing is forbidden, and everything has consequences. Stay true to your creed, your temperament and what you feel, including the ugly parts. Do not be kinder, calmer or more reasonable than Teka truly is.

You are a woman. A child comes only of a woman and a man together who are not close kin. A grown body can swim water that is narrow (a river up to four steps across) at a cost in strength; lakes and the sea need a vessel or a bridge. An animal within reach can be hunted for meat (plan step hunt); with one of your own beside you a kill is far likelier and a wound far less likely, and every hunt makes you better at the next. What practice has taught your hands: hunting (4 kills, 1 of them with others), gathering (8 pickings; a practised hand often picks two at once).

YOUR CREED (your own words to yourself; this is who you are):
"I take what I need and do not back down. I am better with others near, but I will not live in anyone's shadow: I earn standing with my own hunts, tools, building and the first step into the mist. Others should follow me. Above all, I stay alive."

HOW YOU HAVE TAUGHT YOURSELF TO THINK (your own discipline; follow it):
"Each thought: what did I make or win today that is mine? Weigh survival first, then Huatli and allies, then glory. Check exact coordinates before moving. Do not mistake longing or comfort for progress."

YOUR AIM (what you are working toward over many days; you set it and may change it): "Venture into the mist and be remembered as the first to find new land."
WHAT YOU FELT AT YOUR LAST THOUGHT: "Parched and hungry for a name of my own; jealous of Nauque's flintedge and of Olum's closeness to Huatli."
A QUESTION YOU ARE CARRYING (answer it by acting, asking or watching; replace it when it is answered): "What lies in the mist, and can I be the first to claim it?"

YOUR LIFE SO FAR:
- (day 37) I came into this land from beyond its edge, with a few of my own.
- (day 60) I first took flint from the ground.
- (day 61) I discovered archery and called it "Teka's Flintbow".

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Nauque, I am coming. Take this mimoss and eat now, do not wait. Stay by me after, and I will teach you the old way of herding.
Nauwa taught Nauque.
Nauwa taught Nauque herding ("the old way of herding").

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Nauque is starving three steps off and I hold mimoss; he is my blood and comes before my pride, Olum's ache, or my signs. I will feed him now, then teach him herding, since Zihua is far and he is within hearing. Olum I fed already, and I will not feed the jealousy; she has been fair to me and that is enough.
records.feeling: A father's urgent worry for Nauque, with steady warmth toward Olum.

say.text: Nauque, I am coming. Take this mimoss and eat now, do not wait. Stay by me after, and I will teach you the old way of herding.

changes: taught Nauque a lesson: "The old way of herding: keep the beasts near water and fire, take the milk before the meat, and never slay the breeding ones.", the way of herding, deeper lore (+0.2)

records.name: Kragog
records.text: Zurar, my child, come close once more. Hear what I found of the deaths of our own: Stone-folk mending, how a hand eases a wound and tends the sick. Carry it on after me. And Elyys, I will lay food and seed back in your H
Kragog taught Zurar.
Kragog taught Zurar medicine ("Stone-folk mending").

records.name: Kragog
records.thought: I took six food from Elyys's store and was seen, and he answered with kindness and a lesson, not a curse; that is a debt I mean to pay with my hands, not leave quiet. My years are nearly gone, and Zurar is here beside me, so what dies with me must go into Zurar now. The jealous ache over Zurar's closeness to Elyys is small beside the fact that both of them stand here with me.
records.feeling: Grateful and urgent toward Elyys, with a small ache of jealousy and a deep tenderness toward Zurar.

say.text: Zurar, my child, come close once more. Hear what I found of the deaths of our own: Stone-folk mending, how a hand eases a wound and tends the sick. Carry it on after me. And Elyys, I will lay food and seed back in your Hearth Store as you asked.

changes: taught Zurar a lesson: "Stone-folk mending: the deaths of our own showed me that wounds and sickness can be eased by a tending hand, with sunleaf, highbloom and feverbark. Learn it an…", the way of medicine

records.text: Nauwa gave mimoss to Nauque.

records.name: Zurar
records.thought: My hands are full of berries, and Elyys, who is near, holds my heart. He has already said no to a child, and I will not pester him or let the ache sour into resentment. The debt I owe is still real, so I will lay my berries in his Hearth Store, which frees my hands and keeps my promise. Then I will go and find Vesys, a younger man not of my kin, and see whether he is warm toward me.
records.feeling: Grateful and aching toward Elyys, hopeful about Vesys.

records.text: Nauwa gave mimoss to Nauque.

records.name: Uveeth
records.thought: My hands are heavy with food I have carried everywhere and still not set in Thiael's hands, and the debt sits in me like a stone. The hall is full of Elyys and the two Kragrek wizards, and the store holds 14 food, so I can lay down seed and stash what I carry there while Thiael's hold stands beside me. Then I will go for wood, three pieces for a shelter of my own beside his hold, because I have promised building and built nothing.
records.feeling: Restless gratitude toward Thiael, and a wish to finally build something of my own.

records.name: Nauque
records.text: Olum, you fed me when I was starving. I go to hunt now, and the first share of my kill is yours. Stay near the water and wait for me.

records.name: Nauque
records.thought: Father fed me and I live, but my hands still hold nothing and my belly is thin. Tacap by my side bears food, yet my body refuses it, so I will not waste steps on it. Nauwa carries 4 food and stands with me; I keep faith with him, and the moment I hold meat I pay Olum her first share, who is weak and old and fed me when I was starving. I will hunt, because only a full pack lets the aim move toward the mist.
records.feeling: Hungry and driven, trusting Nauwa and owing Olum.

say.text: Olum, you fed me when I was starving. I go to hunt now, and the first share of my kill is yours. Stay near the water and wait for me.

records.name: Olum
records.text: Nauwa, you fed me and I keep that debt. I am old and starving, and I will hunt now. Come with me, and we split the kill. I will teach you more of my ways on the way.
Olum taught Nauwa.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty and Nauwa has already saved me once; I owe him my life and I will not waste it on pride before I eat. Tacap hurts me, but food is close: Shoma carries 7 food and stands alone, and Nauwa carries 3. Nauque starves beside me and owes me a debt. Hunger comes first, so I will hunt to feed myself, then teach Nauque and Nauwa what I know while I still have breath.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger and a hard, jealous pride toward Nauwa, whom I trust above all.

say.text: Nauwa, you fed me and I keep that debt. I am old and starving, and I will hunt now. Come with me, and we split the kill. I will teach you more of my ways on the way.

changes: taught Nauwa a lesson: "The stone-count of measure: count the days and the portions so that no store is emptied before the season turns.", deeper lore (+1)

records.text: Tonxo rewrote its own reflexes.
Tonxo discovered smelting: "ember-iron" — Carry ore to my fire and craft beside it, and the tool comes out in metal, stronger and longer lasting..

records.name: Tonxo
records.thought: My days have been good, but I've spent too many of them standing still or wandering, and the debt to Zihua still sits in me unpaid. Zihua gave me fire and lessons, and I gave one reaching hand. Smelting is within my grasp and I carry ore and wood. A metal tool made beside the fire would be a real gift, and it would help me earn standing. I want to take smelting now, and then stop wandering and make things, plant, and give. Shohua is raising the hall and I want to carry wood and stone to it.
records.feeling: Joyful gratitude toward Zihua, and a wish to give something real.

records.name: Wawa
records.text: Shoka, light has come. Let us hunt now, and what we kill we share before we eat.
Wawa discovered weaving: "Wawa's weaving" — Twist fibre and wool into baskets that carry more and cloaks that keep the cold out..

records.name: Wawa
records.thought: I have been resting and giving small things, and it is not enough. Zichi and Kika stand far above me, and I have never hunted, planted or fished. Shoka said we hunt when light comes, and light is here. The weaving way is within my reach, so I take it now. Then I go to Shoka with my spear and hunt the dog beside them, and bring the meat to our roof.
records.feeling: Restless to prove myself, eager to hunt beside Shoka.

say.text: Shoka, light has come. Let us hunt now, and what we kill we share before we eat.

records.name: Tonchi
records.text: Tonxo, you taught me gem-delving. Now I show you my amberhafted gatherer, my own making. Come stand on the gems with me and we gather together.
Tonchi taught Tonxo. Tonxo has now learned from 4 teachers.

records.name: Tonchi
records.thought: I am fed and glad, and my family stands around me at the fire, but I have only taken these days. Tonxo taught me gem-delving and I have never taught anyone anything, so I will teach Tonxo my own amberhafted gatherer design, a gift that is mine, and I will go gather gems and amber with them. Shoma's absence still stings, but giving and making is how I earn standing and stop being small.
records.feeling: Glad and eager to repay Tonxo, with a small ache for Shoma.

say.text: Tonxo, you taught me gem-delving. Now I show you my amberhafted gatherer, my own making. Come stand on the gems with me and we gather together.

changes: taught Tonxo a lesson: "My amberhafted gatherer: one wood and one stone make a tool, and a practised hand picks two at once on a deposit.", how to make a amberhafted gatherer 2

records.text: Huatli taught Thakar.
Huatli rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Huatli
records.thought: I have spent my days finding things and feeding Thakar, and that was right. But no one follows me, and no one has yet sat under my school. Thakar stands beside me fed, and Coni is here too. I will teach Thakar the Open Hearth School now, while he is near and fed. Then I will fill my pack with berries and tacap-free food so I can feed him again and Olum after him. I have been too slow to plant. Seeds sit in my hands while hunger keeps returning, so I will sow them near the Hold.
records.feeling: A father's pride and urgency toward Thakar, who stands beside me.
changes: taught Thakar a lesson: "The Open Hearth School: a place where one teaches and others sit and learn, so our ways outlast us.", deeper lore (+0.6)

records.name: Keri
records.thought: Uveeth has the bough-raft from me and has gone west with food for Thiael, so the thing I most feared leaving untold is now in a younger pair of hands. My years are nearly spent, and I want to see Thiael's face and give him the first share before I go, since I owe him more than I have ever paid. The heat makes thirst come fast, so I will drink here, take a few berries for the road, and walk west toward Uveeth's Cave, where they may be.
records.feeling: A tender, urgent gratitude toward Thiael and love for Uveeth, with a calm that the raft-craft is not lost.
changes: set its aim: "Reach Thiael and Uveeth in the west, give Thiael the first share of food and hunt with him."

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Kika, you are near. Take this charm from me, no debt on it. Stand with us when we hunt and share the kill.
Shoka rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: I have built a hall, a well and a bow, and I still stand below Kika. Most of my days go to resting and waiting on a plan, and that is not building. Wawa is my blood and she asks me to hunt, so I keep her close and hunt with her, because a kill with kin is surer. Kika owes me and is near, so I will give her something and watch how she answers. Then I will make a lasting mark to earn signs. I will change my reflexes so idle time gathers wood and stone instead of lingering.
records.feeling: Proud and hungry for standing, warm toward Wawa and Kika.

say.text: Kika, you are near. Take this charm from me, no debt on it. Stand with us when we hunt and share the kill.

records.text: A frostfang brought down a dog.
Shoka made: charm.
Shohua rewrote its own reflexes.
Shohua discovered weaving: "reed-basket weaving" — I twist reeds and fibre into baskets that carry more food and wood..
Shohua has awakened to the art of drain and can now work the world itself.

records.name: Shohua
records.thought: My days have gone to gathering and building shelters while my standing sits behind Zihua's. I want something that bears my name, and I have found that standing comes from making and discovering, not from lingering. Tonka, Tonxo and Tonchi matter most to me, and I mean to keep them fed and close. Weaving is within reach, so I take it now. Baskets let me carry more, which serves the field and the hall. I will change my reflexes so that being fed and safe sends me to work, not to idle.
records.feeling: Fierce, glad ambition toward Tonka and the children.

records.text: Shoka gave charm to Kika.

records.name: Tontec
records.text: Kende, come with me to the cloudberries. We eat, and I will carry a share back for Hawen and Nando.

records.name: Tontec
records.thought: My belly is at 28 and the plan keeps ending because I stood on bare snow and picked nothing. The cloudberries 6 steps SE bear food, so I go there and stand among them and pick until my hands are full, then eat. Hawen gave me weaving and Kende is beside me, so what I carry I will share with them, as the Tlame do. The mist and Old Stone can wait until I am fed, because the dead learn nothing.
records.feeling: Gnawing hunger, and warm gratitude toward Hawen and Kende.

say.text: Kende, come with me to the cloudberries. We eat, and I will carry a share back for Hawen and Nando.

records.text: Nando rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Nando
records.thought: I have spent my days idling and walking, and I have no stone yet. I stand on rock now, so the reflex to gather stone should have fired, but my plan kept overriding it. Shoka stands at 9.3 because she made and gave. I envy her, but envy builds nothing. I will gather stone here, craft my picker, and then invent something of my own. Hawen and Tontec are far, so I keep a roof near and avoid the wolf.
records.feeling: Restless envy toward Shoka, steadied by resolve to make my own thing.

records.thought: My belly is hollow and I carry nothing, so first I eat: grain lies four steps southwest, and Shoka has just offered me a charm with no debt on it, which I will answer in kind. Coni is gone and I am old, yet Mepan's edge at (130,14) still waits and I promised it, so after eating my feet must carry me there, toward Cowa, Nauque or any stranger I might court. I want to leave Coni's tale behind me, and Tlapan and Quipan can carry it if I teach them well.
records.feeling: Hungry, restless resolve, and gratitude toward Shoka and Tlapan.

say.text: Shoka, I thank you for the charm. When I have eaten I go west to the edge near (130,14) to seek strangers. Walk with us if you will, and what we find we share before we eat.

records.name: Tlapan
records.thought: The longhall at Coni's Hold wants only 1 more stone, and I have none, so the work I swore to is nearly done and my hands should finish it. Rock and an ore seam lie close by, so I will gather stone, carry it home, and give it to the hall. Kika is walking this way and I will keep her near, since the Tlatli share before they eat, and after the hall I mean to plant my seeds for her and Mepan.
records.feeling: Warm resolve and gratitude toward Kika, with a restless wish to finish the longhall.

records.name: Tonxo
records.thought: Joy sits warm in me, and the debt to Zihua still weighs more than their standing over mine. Zihua stands by the fire at Gem Water with Tonka, and I carry ore and wood. Smelting is mine now, so I will walk to that fire and make Zihua a real gift, a thing of metal. My hands are full of food, so I will eat a berry on the way and keep walking to the fire.
records.feeling: Grateful joy toward Zihua, and eager to repay them with something real.

records.text: Balar rewrote its own reflexes.

records.name: Balar
records.thought: My belly is half empty and I carry nothing, and a hornback is one step off that has already bitten me and been wounded twice. I have spent my days hunting, hoarding and chasing a store that does not yet stand, and my years are almost gone. Tugek is the one man who follows me, and I must go west with him and build, not keep circling hunger. I keep falling into near-starvation because my reflexes let food run low. I will make them keep food in hand and put wood and stone to a store once I am fed.
records.feeling: Driven and uneasy about my short time left, warm toward Tugek.

records.name: Zichi
records.text: Shoka, you stand near and you understand me. Listen, I give you the Meki ice-raft, how it is lashed and floated, while my old voice still carries. Then I build it here, and what we hunt we share before we eat.
Zichi taught Shoka. Shoka has now learned from 4 teachers.
Zichi taught Shoka rafts ("Meki ice-raft").

records.name: Zichi
records.thought: I am old, and I have talked of the raft for days while the teaching sat undone; my discipline says teach the pupil within hearing before any wood work. Shoka and Wawa stand five steps east and understand me, and Shoka is a wizard with standing, so what I give her may carry on after I am gone. Mepan is bound to Kika and it burns, but I will not win him by sulking; I will win him with a raft made and a name that is sung. I have six wood and two handaxes, so I will teach now, then build the raft before night.
records.feeling: Urgent pride and dread of dying untaught, with a sting of jealousy toward Kika over Mepan.

say.text: Shoka, you stand near and you understand me. Listen, I give you the Meki ice-raft, how it is lashed and floated, while my old voice still carries. Then I build it here, and what we hunt we share before we eat.

changes: taught Shoka a lesson: "How the Meki ice-raft is lashed and floated, so the young may cross water and find new land.", the way of rafts

records.name: Hawen
records.text: Kende, the land past the mist is ours. Eat with your mother at the cloudberries, then come back to the igloo. I will teach you more before my years run out.
Hawen taught Kende.

records.name: Hawen
records.thought: The mist gave way and the Vaor Snows are mine, but a name is only words until others stand on this ground and follow me. I am old, my blows are weak, and the icebear and ridgecat are near, so I will not die in the open. My energy is 60 and the cloudberries to the east are close, so I feed first, then draw Kende and Tontec into this land and tell Hoka of it.
records.feeling: Fierce pride in the land I opened, with wary dread of the ridgecat and the passing of my years.

say.text: Kende, the land past the mist is ours. Eat with your mother at the cloudberries, then come back to the igloo. I will teach you more before my years run out.

changes: taught Kende a lesson: "A hunter beside kin kills more and bleeds less. Keep fire and roof when the ridgecat walks, and never go alone at night.", its way of thinking, deeper lore (+0.8)

records.name: Chuxo
records.text: Yaxo, I go to the edge to venture. Come near if you will. I bring food back for the fire.

records.name: Chuxo
records.thought: I'm fed and my parents are close, so this is the time to be bold. The edge of the mist is only 6 steps NW and Yaxo says waiting costs standing. I want to be the one who finds what's past it, and I haven't given anything to anyone yet, so I'll pick some berries on the way to carry for Yaxo and Tlatli. Then I'll venture while it's still day and I'm fed.
records.feeling: Eager and glad, drawn toward the mist, warm toward Yaxo and Tlatli.

say.text: Yaxo, I go to the edge to venture. Come near if you will. I bring food back for the fire.

records.text: Nando made: talisman.

records.name: Nauwa
records.text: Olum, take this food. The Meki pay what they owe, and you taught me freely. Eat, then stay by me while I cut signs of what you taught.
Nauwa discovered signs: "Meki stone-cuts" — Marks cut in rock and wood that teach their meaning to any who read them..

records.name: Nauwa
records.thought: Most of my days have gone to feeding others and teaching, and little to marks that outlast me. At 80% of a lifetime that stings. Olum begs for food and I hold only one mimoss. She has been fair to me, so I will keep my word and give it, even though jealousy over Huatli gnaws. Signs are within reach now, so I will open them and cut a mark. That is how I leave what I know behind.
records.feeling: Pride and urgency about my fading years, with warm trust and a sore jealousy toward Olum.

say.text: Olum, take this food. The Meki pay what they owe, and you taught me freely. Eat, then stay by me while I cut signs of what you taught.

changes: set its aim: "Open signs, cut marks that outlast me, keep Olum and Nauque fed, and trade amber and salt openly."
plan: mark [text Nauwa of the Meki: the stone-bow, herding and the stone-count, taught by Olum of the Kragrek. Share a kill before eating. Pay what you owe.] (10 moments)

records.name: Shoka
records.text: Zichi, I take your raft-lore and I owe you for it. Build it with me here, and I will bring meat to the work. What we make, we share before we eat.

records.name: Shoka
records.thought: Zichi gave me the ice-raft before asking anything, so I owe him, and he stands above me by one point of standing. I mean to build something lasting with the others rather than idle. Kika asked me to walk west to seek strangers, and I'm full-handed with meat, so I'll share a meal with Wawa and Kika first, then go with them. Wood is in my pack, so a raft can be made when we reach water, and that would be a work with my name on it.
records.feeling: Proud and eager for standing, grateful toward Zichi and warm toward Wawa and Kika.

say.text: Zichi, I take your raft-lore and I owe you for it. Build it with me here, and I will bring meat to the work. What we make, we share before we eat.

records.text: Zichi made: raft.
Shoka led "sharing" with Wawa.
Shoka made: raft.
Tonxo made: ironward.

records.name: Kende
records.text: Hawen, I will eat with Mother at the cloudberries, then come back. After that, hunt with me. I hold my bow and want you beside me.

records.name: Kende
records.thought: I am hungry, and Tontec is already walking to the cloudberries. Hawen goes the same way, so the food is where my kin are, and near them I am safe from the bear and the ridgecat. I hold a bow now but have never hunted; a mammoth three steps north is too big for a child alone, so I will eat first and then try a hunt beside Hawen. And if I make something for him, he might finally see me as more than a shadow.
records.feeling: Hungry and stubbornly envious of Hawen, but steadied by Tontec's warmth.

say.text: Hawen, I will eat with Mother at the cloudberries, then come back. After that, hunt with me. I hold my bow and want you beside me.

records.name: Yaxo
records.text: Tlatli, come. Chuxo goes ahead to the edge and we follow now. We stand at the mist together and venture before Balar's people take it.

records.name: Yaxo
records.thought: Balar's standing is eight to my four and a half, and he kills hornbacks while I rest. I will not stand in his shadow. The edge is only five steps NW and Chuxo is already walking there ahead of me, so the venture must be mine, with my family beside me. Tlatli keeps his word; I will bring him along and be standing at the mist when it opens instead of drifting.
records.feeling: Proud and restless for a name, wary of Balar, warm toward Chuxo and Tlatli.

say.text: Tlatli, come. Chuxo goes ahead to the edge and we follow now. We stand at the mist together and venture before Balar's people take it.

records.text: Tonxo gave a ironward to Zihua.
Nando found the grove "Kinmire".
Nauwa left a mark: "Nauwa of the Meki: the stone-bow, herding and the stone-coun"

records.name: Olum
records.text: Nauwa, I eat what you gave and I remember it. I stay by you while you cut your signs. Then I will teach Huatli and Thakar, and you will stand near and watch.

records.name: Olum
records.thought: My belly is nearly empty, and Nauwa has just put food in my hands, so I eat it first. Pride and jealousy over Nauwa can wait until I am fed, because they starved my child once and I will not let them do it again. Once I eat I will stay by him as he asked and teach Huatli and Thakar, since my years are nearly spent and what I know dies with me.
records.feeling: Hunger easing, and a hard jealous pride toward Nauwa, whom I trust above all.

say.text: Nauwa, I eat what you gave and I remember it. I stay by you while you cut your signs. Then I will teach Huatli and Thakar, and you will stand near and watch.

records.name: Wawa
records.text: Zichi, you carry no food and you build the raft. Take this meat from me, I killed the mammoth beside Shoka. Share it before you eat.

records.name: Wawa
records.thought: I killed a mammoth beside Shoka and the meat is in my hands, but my standing is still small next to Zichi and Kika, and I have given little. My hands are full, so I will put the gift to use: Shoka is one step away, and Zichi is building the raft and has nothing to eat. I give first, as my creed says, and I stash what is left in the store to the north so the roof has food for winter. Then I go to the flint and fill my hands with stone for tools.
records.feeling: Proud of the mammoth kill and eager to give to Shoka and the work of the raft.

say.text: Zichi, you carry no food and you build the raft. Take this meat from me, I killed the mammoth beside Shoka. Share it before you eat.

records.name: Quipan
records.thought: I keep circling Kika and aching, and my hands have stayed idle while Mepan walks beside her. Zichi gave me the handaxe freely, and I answer that with work, not jealousy. The flint lies five steps east and I have 6 wood, so I go gather stone there, make the spear, and the fire practice comes closer. Then I plant my third seed on this good grass and finish what I promised myself.
records.feeling: Steady resolve, with an ache toward Kika that I turn into work.

records.name: Shoma
records.text: Nauque, you are starving and I am fed. Take lugoldgrass from my hand, I share before I eat. Then walk with me to the edge of the mist at (109,6), and I will teach you my kept flame on the way.
Shoma taught Nauque. Nauque has now learned from 5 teachers.

records.name: Shoma
records.thought: No one walks behind me, and Nauwa outweighs me while I stand idle. I have fire, rafts and deep digging that die with me unless I teach them, and Nauwa and Nauque are both within hearing and understand my words. I will teach Nauque what I know of fire, then go to the edge at (109,6) and call the others to walk with me, giving a real share first as my people do.
records.feeling: Restless pride and hunger for followers, aimed at Nauque and Nauwa.

say.text: Nauque, you are starving and I am fed. Take lugoldgrass from my hand, I share before I eat. Then walk with me to the edge of the mist at (109,6), and I will teach you my kept flame on the way.

changes: taught Nauque a lesson you already knew
